about: Instruments lifted from NinjaTracker 2 tunes. Each has its own table rows: "wave", "pulse" and "filter" are rows of left+right bytes in editor form; an FF row jumps to a row of the same program, counted from 1 (00 stops). waveStart / pulseStart / filterStart give the row the command points at when it is not row 1. Names and categories are worked out from how each instrument behaves; the tunes do not store names.
